steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Wh-why are those outsiders sticking their noses in our business?!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: And you, Severin! Your son died in that fire! How can you still aid those incompetent swine?!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...Put down the blade and tell me who pushed you to do this? Who gave you those weapons?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Final warning.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Gah—!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That's assault with a deadly weapon. You think you can just go back to your homes? You'll get a knock on your door soon enough. The Gendarmerie will hold you accountable.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Just 'hold them accountable?'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I don't have to explain our accountability processes to a couple of tourists.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Do you have anything at all to tell 'a couple of tourists' then? 'Schultz?'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I do. You're strong. Stronger than I'd expect a doctor to be. Impressive.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And... thank you for the assistance.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Usually, we go by 'Operator.'

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Now can you tell us where Atro is?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It's not safe here. Let's talk somewhere else.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Good work, Miss Folinic.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sorry I'm not much help in battle...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's fine. You did your best. If I'd known what was happening in Wolumonde, I wouldn't have brought you along.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even if we're just helping resolve some disputes, you're too young to be dragged into—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: —*Sigh* ...Fine, fine. Little Lisa's all grown up now. Did you get hurt?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: No, I'm fine.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But you were spacing out back there. What's wrong?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The quarantine zone is right near here. Everything seems to have gone back to peace and quiet after we drove off the protestors.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mm... It doesn't seem that different from any other place.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You're right, it's not that different. They have shops, cafés, ads for music halls and art salons...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No one's getting rounded up by guards and sent out to the tundra to die. They get to live pretty ordinary lives... You might even say they live well.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The Infected get treated so differently all around the world.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: If every place was so good to the Infected...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We'd be out of a job.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Wha?! I mean, that's true, but I'd be really happy about it! E-even though I just became an operator...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm kidding... The fact that Infected can roam the streets freely only serves to underscore how special the situation in Wolumonde is.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...They're hiding something from us.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh? Where did that come from—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Shh! Lower your voice! We'll talk once the officer is gone!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The Infected rebels are acting really weird. And they keep talking about a 'fire' and a 'doctor,' right?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Add in that officer who definitely knows who we are, and who really doesn't want to tell me anything about Atro...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And I can't shake the feeling that something rotten is brewing in this town.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even Leithanien wouldn't go so far as to let the Infected riot in the streets. Where are the guards? Why isn't anyone stopping them?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Now that you mention it...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I've got a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: M-maybe everyone's just a little on edge? Considering what the town's been through...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...I pray that's all it is.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I'm so sorry to have dragged you into all this just as you've arrived. It's shameful...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh, don't worry about it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Are you part of the local Gendarmerie?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Not really. But everyone in Wolumonde undergoes military training. When the time comes, we have a duty to take up arms...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But Uncle... Err, Schultz Severin is our town's highest official.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The middle-aged smoker who really doesn't want to do his job? Too bad, but that irresponsible disregard for duty doesn't exactly come off as mysterious.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: There's a reason he is the way he is—

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: No... never mind...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh right, how should I call you two?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Call me Operator Folinic, and this is Operator Suzuran.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Folinic, Suzuran... these are code names?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Where we come from, most people prefer not to use their real names at work. Just like 'Atro.'

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Dr. Atro...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Seems you're acquainted.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Yes... Sorry. I know you have your doubts, but the Schultz will give you the answers you need. It's not my place to say.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Now, come with me please.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: How much did you tell them?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Not much. Not enough to upset anyone.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: I... I've put forward some unreasonable ideas, but you're always free to reject them.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That's a creative way to dodge responsibility. But you'll get no comfort from me.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If I stood here and told them the whole, unadulterated truth right now, would you be happy? Would that make everyone happy?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: I represent the people, but you're the leader of Wolumonde. What does it matter if we're happy or not?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I don't want to make things difficult. Especially when I'm hosting guests at the same time the Infected are stirring.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: *Sigh*... Put it away. You want to make a good impression on Rhodes Island. Now's not the time to be lighting cigarettes or playing with crossbow bolts.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I think we're well past any good impressions...

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: You——Wait, are they the two young girls out there?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Young girls? Hah, wait until you see them fight. Then you'll start wondering if Leithanian schools focus too much on the arts, just like those bureaucrats.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Sirs, they're here.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Ah, it's the doctors from Rhodes Island! Welcome to Wolumonde! I am so sorry you had to get roped into our local affairs like that. Let us make it up to you with an evening—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Thank you for the offer, but we're only here to establish Dr. Atro's whereabouts. We don't intend to stay long.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So, where is she?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Erm, well—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The local Infected seem to know 'Dr. Atro.' You're stalling, and I'd prefer you not.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Doctors, I'm very sorry, but things in Wolumonde are very complicated right now. We need some time to give your company a proper explanation, in order to guarantee—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: She disappeared.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Wha?!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Sir, when it comes to matters such as this, you might want to shed that flippant attitude of yours.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The truth is flippant. It's simple. No need to sugar coat it. You're angry now, but you're not surprised. You already guessed it, didn't you?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We received the Infected doctor who called herself 'Atro.' And we greatly appreciate her help caring for the many Infected residents of Wolumonde during this difficult time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And you show your appreciation by telling us 'she disappeared?'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No need for hostility here... *Cough*, *hack hack*—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Sir, you look unwell. You should quit smoking.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It would probably be a good idea to get a physical examination, as it could be—

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...No thanks, but I appreciate the concern.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Back to business, after Wolumonde steered over here to avoid Catastrophe, Dr. Atro set up camp on the edge of town. She was housing some Infected residents.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But not long ago, there was a fire in her camp.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...A fire?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know what you're thinking. But according to what we currently know, it seemed to be an accident.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Dr. Atro left town after that. And we don't know where she went.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How can you act like this is all no big deal?!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic! C-calm down!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: We... We'll investigate ourselves. But you tell us she just disappeared after a fire like that's not going to upset us!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...I'm very sorry.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If I'm not going to talk lightly, all I can give you is 'I'm very sorry.'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Dr. Atro is a good egg. She's got no Leithanian blood. No connection to us at all, really. And yet she's nobler than anybody around here.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And when the Catastrophe struck Wolumonde, she didn't run away. She offered us help.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I have the utmost respect for the good doctor. I hope nothing happened to her.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But after the fire, you saw it yourself, some of the Infected folks don't have the same ideas.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Not that I blame them. The town's cut off from the outside world. We're short on supplies. And a gang of armed Infected are out there circling.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Armed Infected?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Outlanders. All of them Infected, all of them armed. Most are Leithanian, but there are a few devils among them.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The term is 'Sarkaz,' please. I hope the meaning of the word is not lost on you. Do you have any other information about the armed Infected?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They're merely vultures waiting to pick our bones. And they're not the first.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh? So why didn't they immediately show up to plunder the town? Why are they just 'loitering' out there?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Just come out with it already.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wolumonde's lack of sensitivity toward the Infected is understandable.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: After all, it's a miracle Leithanien was letting infected people live alongside non-infected people for so long—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: —But it's also an opportunity for bad actors to take advantage of such leniency.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I told you, Rhodes Island isn't just a bunch of doctors. We're also experts at dealing with the Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: There are some areas... where I'd rather trust our own judgment.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: For example... have you ever heard of the 'Reunion Movement?'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Before the Great Rift, I saw that name in the newspapers from time to time. Mostly reports from Ursus, but occasionally in Leithanien.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But to a small tourist town, it doesn't mean much. Folks around here would rather listen to the gossip from the next town over than official reports on faraway countries.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: What are you getting at? You think Reunion has something to do with this?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No, I don't want to jump to conclusions. Let's leave it there for now.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Right... *Cough*. Either way, thanks for the info.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Speaking from experience, I don't think your side of the story will have much influence on our mission.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That's too bad. But honestly, I didn't expect much.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We may have to do some investigating around town. We need to find out what the deal with this 'disappearance' is...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rhodes Island will demand the necessary compensation from the relevant people.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I've no reason to argue with that face of yours.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You can move about the town freely, as Dr. Atro's associates. You are honored guests of Wolumonde.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Ah! But of course! Please, make yourselves at home here. Upstairs is the Wolumonde government's finest parlor.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: You must be tired from your long journey? Please, take a rest upstairs while we—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No need. I have something to attend to.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Can we start our investigation now?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We'll prepare the paperwork and notify the residents after the meeting. As you wish.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Suzuran, let's go.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Oh? Er, okay! See you soon, Wolumonders!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: How long can you keep them in the dark?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Did you see her expression?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You did. Rhodes Island may not be the type of company to try to extort us, but who knows what they might do to avenge a lost colleague?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The way I see it, it all ends the same.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: But... but, it wasn't our fault. Shouldn't they be after the damned Infected that caused the fire?!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We have no proof.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: But we can't just take the blame either!

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: We tolerated the Infected as much as we could, and how did they repay us? Ever since the Gendarmerie left, they've completely been running rampant!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...Indeed. As for the truth, truth is a fickle thing. See this match? Matches are more reliable than the truth.

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: The doctor's right. You really should quit. You've got a long life ahead of you.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They're 'operators.' I only listen to 'doctors.'

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Touché...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tatjana, keep an eye on our guests. Make sure they don't get into trouble.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Ah, yes, sir! Of course!

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Her?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That one, what was the name... Folinic. Yes.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Do you know what Folinic's expression of pain and anger reminded me of?

steps.name: Councilor
steps.text: Don't keep me waiting.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tatjana. It made me think of her. Why didn't she show me a face like that?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Thor was very nearly her husband. You'd think she'd be a little sad.
